mapper.select:
SELECT CONCAT(PRO.FUNDID,PRO.PERIOD) as keyvalue,PRO.NAME, PRO.FUNDID as funcode, PRO.TYPEID, PRO.GROUPID, PD.ID AS id, PD.D_NAME AS DNAME, PRO.TERM, PRO.PAYMENTINTER, PRO.TERMUNIT, PRO.TERMINDAY as theTerm, PRO.ISHOT, PRO.DISORDER, PRO.PREFIX, PRO.OFFLINELIMIT, PRO.ONLINELIMIT, PRO.SCALE, PRO.MONEY, PRO.period, (CASE WHEN PRO.PROFIT IS NULL THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(PRO.PROFIT * 100) END) AS PROFIT, PRO.STATE AS states, PRO.ADNAME, PRO.TEMPLETID, PRO.OFFLINESALELIMIT, PRO.SUSPENSIONLIMIT, TE.TEMPLET_NAME AS TEMPLETNAME, TE.CONTRACTVERSION, PRO.ADTEXT, PRO.FUNDRISKLEVEL, PRO.MSGDATE, (CASE WHEN PRO.APPOINTDATE IS NULL THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PRO.APPOINTDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) AS APPOINTDATE, PRO.DISPLAYLIMIT, (case when PRO.remainamt > 0 then PRO.Remainamt else 0 end) remainamt, PRO.MONEYSTEP, (CASE WHEN PRO.SUBDEADLINE IS NULL THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PRO.SUBDEADLINE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) AS SUBDEADLINE, (CASE WHEN PRO.INTERESTDATE IS NULL THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PRO.INTERESTDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) AS INTERESTDATE, (CASE WHEN PRO.SALESDATE IS NULL THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PRO.SALESDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) AS SALESDATE, (CASE WHEN PRO.MATURITYDATE IS NULL THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PRO.MATURITYDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) AS MATURITYDATE, IBF_GET_LASTNWORKDAY2(PRO.SALESDATE, 1, '') AS APPOINTENDDATE, IBF_GET_CURRENT_WORKDATE(decode(PRO.STATE, '0', '022', '1', '020', 'XXX')) AS currentWorkdate， (SELECT T.TITLE FROM CMWA_FUNDELEMENT T WHERE T.FUNDID = PRO.FUNDID AND T.PERIOD=PRO.PERIOD AND T.SORTNO = '1' AND T.ELETYPE = '220' AND T.STATUS = 'Y') AS TEXTTITLE1, (SELECT T.TITLE FROM CMWA_FUNDELEMENT T WHERE T.FUNDID = PRO.FUNDID AND T.PERIOD=PRO.PERIOD AND T.SORTNO = '2' AND T.ELETYPE = '220' AND T.STATUS = 'Y') AS TEXTTITLE2, (SELECT T.TITLE FROM CMWA_FUNDELEMENT T WHERE T.FUNDID = PRO.FUNDID AND T.PERIOD=PRO.PERIOD AND T.SORTNO = '3' AND T.ELETYPE = '220' AND T.STATUS = 'Y') AS TEXTTITLE3, (SELECT T.CONTENT FROM CMWA_FUNDELEMENT T WHERE T.FUNDID = PRO.FUNDID AND T.PERIOD=PRO.PERIOD AND T.SORTNO = '1' AND T.ELETYPE = '220' AND T.STATUS = 'Y') AS TEXTCONTENT1, (SELECT T.CONTENT FROM CMWA_FUNDELEMENT T WHERE T.FUNDID = PRO.FUNDID AND T.PERIOD=PRO.PERIOD AND T.SORTNO = '2' AND T.ELETYPE = '220' AND T.STATUS = 'Y') AS TEXTCONTENT2, (SELECT T.CONTENT FROM CMWA_FUNDELEMENT T WHERE T.FUNDID = PRO.FUNDID AND T.PERIOD=PRO.PERIOD AND T.SORTNO = '3' AND T.ELETYPE = '220' AND T.STATUS = 'Y') AS TEXTCONTENT3 FROM CMWA_FUND PRO, CMWA_PRODUCT_DEPARTMENT PD, CONTRACT_TEMPLETS TE WHERE PRO.GROUPID = PD.ID(+) AND PRO.TEMPLETID = TE.TEMPLET_ID(+) AND LENGTH(PRO.FUNDID) = '6'
AND PRO.FUNDID =#{sp.fundid}
AND PRO.ADNAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{sp.dname}),'%')
AND STATE IN ('0','1')
order by PRO.INSERTTIMESTAMP desc

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMWA_FUND PRO, CMWA_PRODUCT_DEPARTMENT PD, CONTRACT_TEMPLETS TE WHERE PRO.GROUPID = PD.ID(+) AND PRO.TEMPLETID = TE.TEMPLET_ID(+) AND LENGTH(PRO.FUNDID) = '6'
AND PRO.FUNDID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{sp.fundid}),'%')
AND PRO.ADNAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{sp.dname}),'%')
AND STATE IN ('0','1')
AND PRO.FUNDID IN( SELECT APPS.FUNDID FROM CMWA_FUND PRS INNER JOIN APPOINTREQUEST APPS ON (PRS.FUNDID = APPS.FUNDID) INNER JOIN CUSTINFO CUS ON (APPS.CUSTNO = CUS.CUSTNO) WHERE APPS.PAYST = '0' AND APPS.APPLYST = 'R' AND APPS.CHANNELID = '04' AND APPS.TRANSST = 'N' AND APPS.APKIND IN ('820', '822', '722', '720') AND CUS.INVNM LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{sp.custName}),'%') )

SELECT CUSTNO, TRADEACCO, FUNDID, SHARETYPE, CUSTNO, FUNDACCT, INVNM, EMAIL, FUNDCHINESENM, nvl(SUM(BALANCE),0) - nvl(SUM(ABNMFROZEN),0) - nvl(SUM(CHANGEQUTY),0) as BALANCE, SUM(ABNMFROZEN) as ABNMFROZEN FROM ( SELECT T.TRADEACCO, T.FUNDID, T.SHARETYPE, T.CUSTNO, T.FUNDACCT, T.BALANCE, T.ABNMFROZEN, CI.INVNM, dc.brokeremail AS email, FI.fundnm as FUNDCHINESENM, tq.CHANGEQUTY FROM FUNDBALCONS T LEFT JOIN CUSTINFO CI ON T.CUSTNO = CI.CUSTNO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT C.CUSTNO,C.BROKERNAME,C.BROKEROFFICETEL,c.brokeremail FROM DS_CUSTINFOADD C WHERE C.BROKERPRIV IN ('2', '0') --'0':全部 ；'1':账户； '2'：交易 AND C.INFOFLAG = 'B' --'I':证件信息，'B':经办人信息 AND C.MAINBROKERFLAG = 1 ) DC ON t.custno = DC.CUSTNO LEFT JOIN FUNDINFO FI ON T.FUNDID = FI.FUNDID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRADEACCO, FUNDID, SUM(CHANGEQUTY) AS CHANGEQUTY FROM TRADEREQUEST_QTRACE GROUP BY TRADEACCO, FUNDID ) tq ON t.tradeacco = tq.tradeacco AND t.fundid = tq.fundid WHERE BALANCE > 0 AND dc.brokeremail is not null AND IBF_GET_CYCLEENDDT(T.FUNDID, T.CYCLEINIDT, #{allowedRedeemDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) = #{allowedRedeemDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY CUSTNO, TRADEACCO,FUNDACCT,FUNDID,SHARETYPE,INVNM,EMAIL,FUNDCHINESENM

SELECT T.FUNDID as FUNDID , FI.fundnm as FUNDCHINESENM, SUM(T.BALANCE) as BALANCE FROM FUNDBALCONS T LEFT JOIN FUNDINFO FI ON T.FUNDID=FI.FUNDID WHERE BALANCE > 0 AND IBF_GET_CYCLEENDDT(T.FUNDID, T.CYCLEINIDT, #{allowedRedeemDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) = #{allowedRedeemDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T.FUNDID,fi.fundnm

WITH T1 AS ( SELECT TRADEACCO TRADEACCO, FUNDACCT FUNDACCT, FUNDID FUNDID, NVL(BALANCE, 0) BALANCE FROM (SELECT T2.TRADEACCO, T2.FUNDACCT, T2.FUNDID, T2.BALANCE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRADEACCO, FUNDACCT, FUNDID ORDER BY CLEARDT DESC , t2.update_date desc) ROW_NUMBER FROM WAECUSER.HS_FUNDBALANCE T2 ) WHERE ROW_NUMBER = 1)
SELECT TRADEACCO, FUNDACCT, FUNDID, MAX(SALE_BALANCE) AS SALEBALANCE, MAX(TA_BALANCE) AS TABALANCE FROM (
SELECT TRADEACCO, FUNDACCT, FUNDID, BALANCE AS SALE_BALANCE, 0 AS TA_BALANCE FROM (SELECT T2.TRADEACCO, T2.FUNDACCT, T2.FUNDID, NVL(T2.BALANCE, 0) BALANCE FROM WAECUSER.FUNDBALANCE T2 MINUS SELECT * FROM T1)
UNION ALL
SELECT TRADEACCO, FUNDACCT, FUNDID, 0 AS SALE_BALANCE, BALANCE AS TA_BALANCE FROM (
SELECT * FROM T1
MINUS
SELECT T2.TRADEACCO, T2.FUNDACCT, T2.FUNDID, NVL(T2.BALANCE, 0) BALANCE FROM WAECUSER.FUNDBALANCE T2 )) WHERE SALE_BALANCE <> TA_BALANCE GROUP BY TRADEACCO, FUNDACCT, FUNDID ORDER BY TRADEACCO, FUNDACCT, FUNDID
